questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript

questions.rationale: React is recommended for the requested clean, reusable dashboard frontend.

options.label: React

questions.question: What should the frontend include?
questions.answer: Responsive, mobile-first business dashboard with a visible photo background and dark glassmorphism; cyan/teal and gold accents; RWF balance, daily income, task rewards, commission and bonus; Deposit, Withdraw, Earn and History actions; active plans, income/day, total deposited, Daily Earning, check-in, gift code, Spin & Win and support; bottom navigation for Home, Plans, Invite and Me. Use representative demo data only; do not implement real financial transactions or a transaction backend.
questions.rationale: These requirements are taken directly from the project request.
questions.recommendedChoice: Responsive, mobile-first business dashboard with a visible photo background and dark glassmorphism; cyan/teal and gold accents; RWF balance, daily income, task rewards, commission and bonus; Deposit, Withdraw, Earn and History actions; active plans, income/day, total deposited, Daily Earning, check-in, gift code, Spin & Win and support; bottom navigation for Home, Plans, Invite and Me. Use representative demo data only; do not implement real financial transactions or a transaction backend.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: The requested build is a frontend prototype and explicitly excludes a real transaction backend.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use frontend demo data only; no persistent data service is needed.
